original_evidence: Before any probing, record the found order
that sampling or analysis is sequenced first or the probe is withheld for those items
Apply the same probe sequence to every item
Where feasible, the person capturing and logging responses works without knowledge of the hypothesised sequence
neutral_evidence: Before probing, record the found order
perform that sampling or analysis first or withhold probing for the affected items
Apply the same sequence to every item
Where feasible, have the person capturing and logging responses work without knowledge of the sequence hypothesized from textual clues
operation_preserved.rationale: The paraphrase preserves item documentation, baseline photography, conservator oversight, analysis sequencing, probe selection and exposure order, prohibited methods, comparison items, and conditional blinding.

original_evidence: localized on the sheet, absent in the ordinary-light baseline, and reproduced on a second capture
which may or may not be legible as text
Non-responses are recorded per item and per probe with the same care as responses.
neutral_evidence: localized on the sheet, absent from the initial visible-light photograph and reproduced in a second capture
whether or not legible as text
Record non-responses by item and probe with the same care
signal_preserved.rationale: All three signal criteria remain mandatory. Trace types, possible illegibility, recording details, non-responses, and comparison responses are retained.

original_evidence: only that material capable of producing that response is present at that location
shared stock among items supports grouping them, not ordering them
direction (A written after B) argued only if A's ink can be seen to run across the indentations
only if that object's association with the letter is independently supported
conflict is kept as alternative chronologies
neutral_evidence: only the presence, at its recorded location, of material capable of producing that response
Shared stock supports grouping items without ordering them.
the direction A written after B is argued only if A's ink can be seen to run across the indentations
only when the object's association with that letter is independently supported
retain conflicts as alternative chronologies
inference_preserved.rationale: The graded inferences retain their conditions: manufacture bounds, grouping without ordering, conditional writing-event direction, independently supported transfer of object dates to letters, and storage contact without writing order. Interval narrowing and unresolved conflicting chronologies are preserved.

original_evidence: a non-response therefore does not show that an item is unrelated, of different date, or never posted
paper date is not writing date, writing date is not posting date
if no anchor survives corroboration, only a relative or grouped chronology with stated open alternatives is justified
Feasibility depends on unverified assumptions about access to originals, equipment, and conservator approval.
neutral_evidence: It therefore does not establish that an item is unrelated, differently dated or never posted.
Paper date does not establish writing date, writing date does not establish posting date
If no independently dated reference survives corroboration, the justified result is restricted to relative or grouped chronology with stated open alternatives
Feasibility depends on unverified access to originals, equipment and conservator approval.
limit_preserved.rationale: Alternative causes, detection failures, negative inference limits, distinctions between event dates, association uncertainty, cumulative probe costs, and feasibility qualifications remain explicit. The absence of a corroborated dating anchor still precludes absolute dates. Unknown originality, period, paper type, detectable traces, and dated comparison availability are also retained.

original_evidence: stop on an item when the agreed exposure ceiling is reached, when any condition change is seen, or when a repeat capture adds no new localized response
stop the whole procedure if the conservator withdraws approval
neutral_evidence: Stop work on an item when its exposure ceiling is reached, any condition change is seen, or repeat capture adds no new localized response.
Stop the entire procedure if the conservator withdraws approval.
stopping_condition_preserved.rationale: All three item-level stopping triggers and the procedure-wide approval trigger are preserved, despite relocation to the limits field.

original_evidence: every latent-trace constraint is checked against at least one independent anchor or another reference document before it is used to fix a date
neutral_evidence: Before any constraint derived from a previously undetected material trace is used to fix a date, check it against at least one independent dated reference or another reference document.
next_inquiry_preserved.rationale: The follow-up retains universal coverage, the minimum corroboration requirement, the alternative reference-document route, and the requirement to perform this check before fixing a date. In this chronology context, the dated-reference wording preserves the anchor's function.

original_evidence: storage-contact traces: ink offset, stains, fastener rust marks or fold shadows shared between sheets
Each inferred constraint is entered as an interval or a pairwise relation alongside the ordinary clues
when any condition change is seen, or when a repeat capture adds no new localized response
neutral_evidence: Offset, stains, rust and fold shadows concern physical contact and storage relationships.
Intervals and pairwise relations are combined with independent documentary clues
Non-responses, changes in item condition and whether repeat capture produces any new localized response are also recorded or monitored.
no_added_operational_content.rationale: The additional decomposition field reorganizes existing entities and relations. Monitoring condition and repeat-capture novelty expresses requirements already implicit in the original stopping rules. No new probe, inference permission, threshold, or follow-up is introduced.

original_evidence: possible carriers of latent residues
each chosen because the suspected residue promotes a response
neutral_evidence: previously undetected material traces
Select probes according to the suspected trace's capacity to produce a response
no_source_imagery.rationale: The paraphrase uses literal descriptions of material traces and imaging behavior without naming a source discipline or retaining a source-domain metaphor. Sheets, envelopes, probes, fluorescence, and other target entities remain appropriately explicit.

no_verdict_language.rationale: Neither text evaluates the procedure as ordinary, novel, creative, unorthodox, a formalization, a departure, or as adding or lacking a warrant. The paraphrase describes behavior and evidential conditions; its inferential_warrant field label does not make an evaluative claim.
